name: fung
about: 馮 (Fung, the Cantonese spelling of the surname) as a neon sign, a still for the user, 2026-09-29: 冫 (two dots) and 馬 (horse). No small line: none we could stand behind. Clips trace the data's own stroke order: 冫 (strokes 0-1, the ice radical, 'two-dot water') first, then 馬 (2-11). An override drawing 馬 first was a misreading, removed the same day.

music.why: The Receptive's track (Analog Dreams, 90 bpm), the user's favourite of the first shorts; calm, for a sign that draws itself in
